During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stage an '''attack''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kostra]]. During the engagement, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Fulkrehm Protial]] was forced down in his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] and exposed to near-fatal levels of [[trosilon]] [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxin]].<ref name="CRO-" /> Aboard the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia Organa]] visited the world to secretly support the Rebel cause. She transmitted mesages, dispensed much-needed material, and brought time for the Rebel evacuation.<ref name="TEA" />
